metadata.title: TRAITÉ DE CHIMIE TECHNOLOGIQUE ET INDUSTRIELLE

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and unbracketed, hairline serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (popularized by Didot and Bodoni), which was the standard for French academic and formal printing in the 19th century.
